The context doesn't name an environment variable for a pass-rate threshold, so I don't know of one from these documents.

The quality-gate examples hardcode the 95% threshold in shell scripts rather than reading it from an environment variable. For example: "if (( $(echo "$PASS_RATE < 95" | bc -l) )); then" [promptfoo/site/docs/integrations/ci-cd.md]. The `--fail-on-error` flag in the same section fails the build on any test failure, not on a pass-rate threshold: "npx promptfoo@latest eval --fail-on-error" [promptfoo/site/docs/integrations/ci-cd.md].

The environment variables table in promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md is truncated in the retrieved context, so I can't rule out a threshold variable there. Checking the full table or the promptfoo source would settle it.
